why.primary_action_salience: E740's orange button competes with its own colour-accented 'Edit' link, splitting attention, while 512A/E597 keep Edit/Cancel neutral so the purple 送る button reads as the one clear action; E597's button looks marginally larger/bolder than 512A's, giving it a hair more emphasis.
why.control_visibility: All three show Cancel/Edit/送る legibly, but in E740 the coloured 'Edit' text visually rivals the primary button's weight, blurring which control outranks which; 512A and E597 keep Edit and Cancel in the same neutral tone so the primary/secondary split is unambiguous, with E597's slightly bigger button sharpening that split a touch more.
why.visual_craft: 512A and E597 share a consistent two-tier colour system (neutral secondary text, single accent on the primary button) which reads as more deliberate than E740, where the orange button plus a separately-coloured Edit link feels like two competing accents; between the two purples the difference is subtle and low-confidence, but 512A's button padding looks marginally tighter/more precisely fitted to its label.
why.semantic_colour: The action sends a message out of the app to other people (#sales), which is closer to a 'proceed with awareness' action than a neutral confirm; E740's amber/orange carries that caution connotation, whereas the violet/purple used in 512A and E597 reads as a generic brand-primary colour with no specific tie to 'this leaves the app', so it is semantically weaker here even though it looks calmer.
why.overall: 512A and E597 both beat E740 on hierarchy and craft consistency (one clean accent colour vs. two clashing ones), and are close enough to each other that the choice is marginal (E597's slightly larger button vs. 512A's slightly tighter one); E740 wins only on semantic colour matching (caution-tinted orange for an outbound action) but loses enough on clarity/consistency to rank last overall.

differences: Send button colour: E740 uses an orange/amber fill; 512A and E597 both use a purple/violet fill.

In E740 the 'Edit' label is rendered in a colour (purple/blue) distinct from the neutral grey 'Cancel', whereas in 512A and E597 'Edit' is a plain light/white neutral tone matching Cancel's treatment apart from brightness.

512A and E597 are otherwise visually near-identical (same layout, spacing, copy, and purple hue); the only difference I can see between them is a subtle one in the 送る button's apparent size/padding, with E597's button reading marginally larger/bolder than 512A's — this specific distinction is low-confidence given how close the two renders are.
No differences observed in text content, header ('# Slack 外部に出る'), field labels (宛先/差出人/出所), or overall card layout across all three.
